welcome_message.title: Welcome to The Meadow
welcome_message.body: Here is a quick tour of how to connect with others in the meadow.

tour.title: The Meadow
tour.body: Scroll through the meadow to discover ongoing conversations and people nearby.

tour.title: Butterflies
tour.body: Tap a butterfly to view their profile and send a message or friend request.

tour.title: Conversation flowers
tour.body: Flowers represent active chats. Tap one to join and see the topic bubble.

tour.title: Start a chat
tour.body: Use the flower button to start a new conversation. A new flower blooms in the meadow.

tour.title: Keep exploring
tour.body: Scroll to move between sections when there are many conversations.

post_tour_tip: You can revisit the meadow tour from Settings > Info & tour.
revisit_instructions: Open Settings to replay this tour whenever you want a refresher.
